name: Lattice Loader
description: Inline status loader with a 3x3 or 4x4 grid of pulsing cells, a label and a live timer. Morphs into a done or error pictogram with a swapped label when the status changes.
contents: Grid of animated cells that light up in a named or custom pattern
Overlay grid that draws a done or error mark
Status label that crossfades between working, done and error text
Screen reader only live status announcement
behavior: While status is working, cells pulse in sequence with staggered animation delays in a looping pattern
Switching to done or error pauses and fades out the pattern and fades in a mark grid in green or red
Label crossfades with a blur between the three labels
Timer counts up every 100ms while working and freezes on finish, or shows the elapsed prop when given
Screen reader announcement updates on status change with the spoken duration
Reduced motion setting turns the pattern into a slow synchronized fade and removes the mark and text transitions
editableByProps: Working, done and error label text
Status, pattern, grid size 3 or 4, and cell shape
Cell, done and error colors, glow on or off and glow color
Cell size, gap, font size, animation speed and idle opacity
Timer visibility and externally supplied elapsed seconds
Custom pattern through an object with cells, loop, scale and lit
Extra class names and inline style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the done or error mark shapes
Add a fourth status such as paused
needsCodeEdit.where: status handling in the markRef logic and the three label spans

fixed: Only 3x3 and 4x4 grids are supported, any other grid value becomes 3
Named patterns exist only for some grid sizes, a pattern missing for the chosen grid falls back to orbit on 3 or sweep on 4
Injects a style tag with keyframes and reduced motion rules per instance
Relies on Tailwind arbitrary value and group data attribute classes
Lit duration is limited to presets 62, 45, 35 and 25 percent, other lit values fall back to 62
Timer text is written directly to the DOM and does not rerender
Mark layout is fixed per grid size for the done and error pictograms
Small inline element that works on all screen sizes
